title: Velocity of Q after collision
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the velocity of block Q immediately after the elastic collision, obtaining 1.68 m/s.

title: Distance Q travels
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the distance block Q slides before stopping, obtaining 0.504 m.

title: Apply momentum conservation
description: Important: The student must set up and apply the conservation of linear momentum for the elastic collision between ball P and block Q.

title: Use velocity ratio
description: Important: The student must correctly use the given 5:1 ratio to find the velocity of ball P after the collision.

title: Calculate Q's deceleration
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the deceleration of block Q using Newton's second law and the kinetic friction force.

title: Use kinematics for distance
description: Important: The student must correctly apply a kinematics equation (e.g., v² = u² + 2as) to find the sliding distance of block Q.

title: Interpret centripetal acceleration
description: Optional: The student may verify or use the given centripetal acceleration to find the speed of ball P before collision.

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly assigns signs to the velocities in the momentum conservation equation.

title: Friction force mistake
description: Pitfall: The student uses the wrong formula for kinetic friction (e.g., omits gravity or normal force).
